revenue.source: FY2025 Form 10-K (cat-20251231.htm / ARS cat015318-ars.pdf): total sales and revenues 2025 $67.589bn, 2024 $64.809bn; 2023 $67.06bn (reported as $67.1bn in 4Q23 release; exact figure from prior 10-K, not re-verified in this session)

operating_income.source: FY2025 Form 10-K ARS cat015318-ars.pdf, consolidated results of operations: Operating profit 11,151 / 13,072 / 12,966 (2025/2024/2023)

d_and_a.source: FY2025 10-K Statement 5 cash flow: Depreciation and amortization 2,262 / 2,153 / 2,144 (2025/2024/2023)

capex.source: FY2025 10-K Statement 5: Capex excl. equipment leased to others (1,597/1,988/2,821 for 2023/24/25) PLUS expenditures for equipment leased to others (1,495/1,227/1,465); gross of disposal proceeds; included leased since D&A includes leased-asset depreciation

revenue_growth.source: Assumption: FY2025 growth was 4.3%; Q3'25 +10% and management commentary points to higher volumes (data-center power, services); fades to GDP-plus levels over cycle.

ebit_margin.source: Assumption: FY2025 operating margin 16.5% (11,151/67,589) depressed by tariffs; FY2023-24 were 19.3%/20.2%; assume modest recovery to 17% held flat, below the cycle peak.

tax_rate.source: Assumption: approximate normalized effective rate near the 21% US statutory plus state/foreign mix; not verified against FY2025 10-K effective rate.

capex_pct_revenue.source: Assumption: FY2025 gross capex 6.3% of revenue (4,286/67,589); management guides higher 2026 capex (~$3.5bn for MP&E, per 4Q25 call) so stays elevated, trending slightly lower.

wacc.source: Assumption: cost of equity ~9.5% (beta ~1.1, rf ~4.3%, ERP ~5%) and after-tax cost of debt ~4%, with mid-single-digit-% debt weight of mkt cap; rounded to 8.5%. Not from a data provider.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run nominal GDP/inflation-ish growth, below WACC.

net_debt.source: FY2025 10-K / 4Q25 release balance sheet at 12/31/2025: short-term borrowings 5,514 + LT debt due within one year 7,120 + LT debt due after one year 30,696 = 43,330 consolidated (includes Financial Products debt), less cash, cash equivalents and restricted cash 9,986 (Statement 5; ~$10.0bn enterprise cash). No separate short-term investments found. Note: consolidated net debt incl. captive finance debt; reviewer may prefer ME&T-only.

diluted_shares.source: Derived, not directly read: FY2025 profit $8,884m / diluted profit per share $18.81 = ~472.3m shares (millions). Weighted-average diluted share count from the 10-K not retrieved (search limit hit); reviewer should confirm.
